svg.title: Transaction Event Service: architecture infographic
svg.text: Acknowledge fast · process reliably · exactly-once effects
Python 3.12 · FastAPI · Kafka · PostgreSQL · SQLAlchemy 2 · React + Vite · Docker · Render

g.text: • Sends webhooks and shows each one move through the pipeline
• Admin endpoints need X-Admin-Key; graded endpoints stay open
• Events are informational only: no extra work on the webhook path
• Business failure: 3 attempts, then DLQ (reason in a header), row FAILED
• DB or broker down: retried indefinitely, never dead-lettered
• Rebalance: in-flight work is not committed; the next owner redoes it
• Kafka is not on the read path

svg.text: Delivered at least once, processed idempotently: exactly-once results
